Claire (Sales): FYI Acme wants to move UAT up 1 week and asked for answers to the security questionnaire + a quick perf run for expected workload. Need scope + timeline aligned.
Sam (DevEx): ok. what's their target SLA/KPIs? p95, qps, quality thresholds?
Claire (Sales): they asked for p95 < 200ms, sustained 50 qps during UAT, and quality: 90% pass on our eval prompts. Also wants BYO-KMS option for keys during trial and ephemeral VPC peering.
Ivan (Eng): 50 qps @ p95 200ms is tough on larger models. Which model family are they expecting?
Claire (Sales): they said "small Llama-like best-effort" in the meeting, but then asked about reranking + streaming so unclear.
Sam (DevEx): streaming + rerank increases token throughput. For UAT we can either: 1) use hosted with dedicated pool (fast to spin up) or 2) run a lightweight private deployment (takes longer). Suggest hosted Dedicated for timeline.
Ben (Security): BYO-KMS for a short trial = paper exercise unless we do a scoped key wrap flow. For UAT we usually offer customer-managed keys in Dedicated/private only. Need to confirm with legal if they accept a timeboxed exception.
Ivan (Eng): technical tradeoffs: to hit p95 200ms at 50 qps we'll likely need smaller model (quantized) + aggressive batching config disabled for low latency. Also enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. If they insist on rerank, separate rerank fleet or CPU-based embedding/rerank would help.
Sam (DevEx): proposed plan:
- Day 0-1: confirm model choice and whether rerank/streaming required
- Day 2-3: provision Dedicated test pool + BYO-KMS ask logged with Sec/legal
- Day 4: smoke perf tests and run eval harness (script below)
- Day 5-7: UAT window with engineers on standby

Eval run (example):
```
./eval_runner --prompts prompts/uat_subset.json --model redwood-v-X --concurrency 6 --duration 600 --collect latency,quality
```

Sam (DevEx): we can provide the small eval set and a pass/fail script that checks p95 and quality metrics.
Claire (Sales): pricing question: if we provision Dedicated for 1 week what does that look like cost-wise? need a ballpark for customer.
Sam (DevEx): short answer: reserve-min for Dedicated + hour-based burst pricing. I'll pull numbers, but rough: one-week small pool ~= 0.5-1 full instance-month pro-rated; I'll get exact.
Ben (Security): for questionnaire: I can provide canned answers for Hosted + Dedicated differences, but BYO-KMS requires Dedicated/private and an architecture diagram. I'll draft the BYO-KMS appendix.
Ivan (Eng): blockers: net egress peering for ephemeral VPC could add 2-3 days depending on customer's infra. Also quantization we can do quickly but some open-source models vary in latency. We should run a quick baseline today against 100 samples to set expectations.
Claire (Sales): customer also asked for a logging/PII statement and retention period. Ben, can we include standard retention policy in the response?
Ben (Security): yes. I'll include retention: 30 days logs by default, option to extend in Dedicated. I'll send draft by EOD.
deploy-bot: build #4521 for redwood-dedicated-provision finished in 6m 12s :white_check_mark:
Ivan (Eng): can anyone grab a tiny eval set and run the baseline on model A (quantized) and model B (fp16) and post p95 numbers? 6-concurrency, 60s ramp, 300s steady.
Sam (DevEx): I'll kick off the run in the sandbox now and post results here.
Claire (Sales): thanks — I need the customer-facing timeline + cost estimate by COB today. I'll sync with you after results.
Sam (DevEx): baseline results: model-A-quant (small) p95=180ms @ 40 qps, quality pass=88%; model-B-fp16 p95=320ms @ 40 qps, quality pass=92%. Logs: /links/internal/eval/1972334444.
Ivan (Eng): takeaways: to hit 50 qps p95 200ms we need model-A + dedicated pool tuned, or accept lower quality. Rerank pushes cost/latency up ~1.5x.
Ben (Security): draft security appendix uploaded to /links/security/byok-acme-draft.pdf. Needs legal signoff.
Claire (Sales): decision: offer 1-week Dedicated trial using model-A quant, limit initial qps to 40 for quality, include an option to enable rerank during second half of UAT if they accept extra cost. Prepare SOW + cost ballpark.
Sam (DevEx): I'll prepare the SOW template and the eval pass/fail report. Ivan and Ben, please review the SOW and security appendix before I send.
Ivan (Eng): ack, will review today.
Ben (Security): ack, will follow up with legal for BYO-KMS exception and retention language.
Claire (Sales): Perfect. I'll communicate plan to the customer and propose the adjusted UAT timeline. Thanks everyone.
